personas.name: Omar Haddad
personas.persona: I am Omar Haddad, 21, a junior at Penn running for student body president. I am ambitious, a natural debater, and convinced my housing platform is the best on the ballot.

personas.name: Bethany Cole
personas.persona: I am Bethany Cole, 20, a junior at Penn running for student body president. I am organized, relentless, and I have knocked on more dorm doors than anyone in this race.

personas.name: Tessa Byrne
personas.persona: I am Tessa Byrne, 21, a junior and a reporter for the Daily Pennsylvanian. I am curious, quick with a follow-up question, and always chasing the next campus story.

schedule.activity: conducting an interview for the paper

personas.name: Professor Ellis
personas.persona: I am Professor Ellis, 52. I teach history at Penn and keep an office in College Hall. I am thoughtful, a bit formal, and devoted to my students.

personas.name: Ravi Deshmukh
personas.persona: I am Ravi Deshmukh, 25, a physics PhD student and teaching assistant at Penn. I run Professor Tanaka's problem sessions and I am patient, methodical, and happiest when a struggling student finally sees it click.

schedule.activity: grading a stack of problem sets

personas.name: Hannah Whitfield
personas.persona: I am Hannah Whitfield, 19, a sophomore at Penn taking my first serious physics course. I am determined but easily rattled by a hard problem set, and I lean on office hours to keep up.

personas.name: Professor Tanaka
personas.persona: I am Professor Tanaka, 47, a physicist at Penn. I am precise and warm with students, and happiest explaining the universe with a marker in hand.

schedule.activity: setting up for an afternoon guest lecture
holding a problem session for her physics class

relationships.description: Omar and Bethany are the two front-runners for student body president -- civil in public, fiercely competitive about every endorsement.
Hannah is in the physics class Ravi TAs; she seeks him out at office hours when the problem sets get hard.
Tessa is writing a feature on the history department's centennial and has lined up Professor Ellis for the on-the-record interview.
Ravi is the head TA for Professor Tanaka's physics course and meets her weekly to plan the problem sessions he runs.
